thread:
Maria: Hey team — quick heads up: spotting ~8% of inbound leads stuck in enrichment step for >30s, causing RR slot skips.
Diego: Ugh. Is this HubSpot enrichment service latency or our webhook retries?
Jess: Noticed a few MQLs getting default owner after timeout yesterday.
Sam: I'm looking at the webhook logs now, pinging the enrichment lambda.
routing-bot: [ALERT] post-enrichment queue depth 42 -> backoff triggered :warning:
Sam: Found a pattern: when enrichment latency spikes, our RR assign worker marks lead as 'unassigned' and passes to fallback pool after 15s.
Maria: Can we increase the fallback delay to 30s for skill-based routing campaigns only? That should reduce unnecessary default-claims.
Diego: +1 for campaign-level config. Also want a cooldown per-owner to avoid rapid reassigns.
Jess: For the webinar leads (EMEA timezone) we need immediate handoff under 10s; can we make that an override?
Sam: Proposed small change:
```json
{"fallback_delay_s": 30, "campaign_overrides": {"webinar-emea": {"fallback_delay_s": 10}}}
```
Sam: I'll open a canary PR to infra and add a heartbeat metric: `lead.assign_latency_ms`.
Nora: Could we also add an alert if more than 5% of leads hit fallback in a 5m window? CS sees the fallout.
Diego: Let's update HubSpot workflow to mark 'enrichment_pending' and only trigger owner assignment once cleared — reduces race.
Maria: Plan: Sam -> PR + canary to marketing RR (10% traffic), Diego -> HS workflow change, Jess -> confirm webinar override list, Nora -> monitor CS queue. Target: deploy by EOD tomorrow.
Jess: tagging @everyone for visibility, will update the campaign doc with override IDs.
Maria: Thanks. :thumbsup: If any blockers ping me. We'll debrief in stand.
